svg.title: Multilayer mirror records and what eleven reflections leave
svg.desc: Two bar charts: best measured peak reflectance of one multilayer mirror — Mo/Si 70.15 % at 13.5 nm, Ru/Be 72.2 % at 11.4 nm, Mo/Be 68.7 % at 11.3 nm, La/B 64.1 % at 6.65 nm, LaN/B 57.3 % at 6.6 nm — and the fraction left after 11 reflections, from 2.8 % down to 0.22 %.
svg.title: Multilayer mirror records and what eleven reflections leave
